name: I Was Reincarnated as the 7th Prince so I Can Take My Time Perfecting My Magical Ability
description: Prince Lloyd wasn't always a prince...in fact, his previous life is one he remembers perfectly: he was a sorcerer, of sorts. So when he was forced to reincarnate, he decided to continue his studies, prince of the realm or no! But his new life has its own sets of challenges...including being a 10-year-old! What's the 7th prince/sorcerer to do?!

videos.title: I Reincarnated as the Seventh Prince
videos.overview: A mage, lacking both talent and lineage, is burned to death by the magic he loves. He's reborn as Lloyd, seventh prince of the Saloum Kingdom, with his past memories intact. One day, in a forbidden library, he awakens a demon that wields ancient magic...

videos.title: I Encountered an Adventurer
videos.overview: After making the Demon Grimoire his familiar, Lloyd sets out in pursuit of a dungeon with magically enchanted items and encounters Tao, a martial artist who uses Qi techniques. Lloyd assumes the alter ego of Robert and heads deep into a dungeon with her.

videos.title: Like Qi Techniques and Enchantment Magic
videos.overview: Deep within the dungeon lies a demonic lich that has laid many adventurers to rest. After forcing Robert to escape, Tao faces the threat alone, but is overwhelmed by the difference in power. However, just as the lich is about to finish her off...

videos.title: Headed Out for a Monster Hunt
videos.overview: With an interest in weapon enchantments and their effectiveness, Lloyd joins Albert and Sylpha on a monster hunt. After meeting Tao and reaching their destination the group encounters a pack of bearwolves, who regenerate unnaturally quickly.

videos.title: The Demon Is Angry
videos.overview: Just when it seemed Sylpha was able to overpower the pack of bearwolves, the demon Pazuzu emits a miasma that has the knights collapsing to the ground. Once even Sylpha and Tao are rendered unable to retaliate, Lloyd finally makes his move.

videos.title: Sisters, Monsters, Spellbound Swords, and Brothers
videos.overview: With his new bearwolf, Shiro, in tow, Lloyd visits his sister, Alieze, in order to learn how to communicate with monsters. Afterward Lloyd is reunited with another brother, Dian, a blacksmith who is seeking to create the ultimate Spellbound Sword.

videos.title: I'm Going to Battle Some Assassins
videos.overview: The kingdom has been infiltrated by a girl named Ren from the Assassin's Guild. Upon learning of her special ability as the Poison Blighted, Lloyd tracks her back to her hideout, sneaks in, and is attacked by a group of assassins with unique abilities.

videos.title: I'm Going to Meet Jade
videos.overview: Having formed a connection with the Assassin's Guild members, Lloyd's curiosity is captured by the leader Jade's teleportation ability. Lloyd and the others head to Lordost Manor, where the guild is happy to be reunited with Jade, until...

videos.title: The Calamity Named Guisarme
videos.overview: Ren is confronted by the demon lord Guisarme, who has stolen Jade's body and teleportation power. Guisarme is intent on seizing the bodies of the Assassin's Guild as well, when Lloyd arrives in the neck of time to defend them.

videos.title: Sylpha's Blade
videos.overview: As Lloyd and Guisarme engage in fierce combat, the members of the Assassin's Guild are cornered by a horde of demons. Using the control of their abilities given to them by Lloyd's spell, the Guild resists, but are gradually overwhelmed by their enemies.

videos.title: Jade's Last Words
videos.overview: Guisarme's teleportation-powered offensive barrage leaves Lloyd perplexed. Having come to a realization, he attempts a physical attack with a magic-absorbing sword named Spelltaker, aiming to decipher the nature of Jade's stolen power.

videos.title: Lloyd's Answer
videos.overview: Guided by Jade's will, Lloyd deciphers the spell for teleportation. Pushed to the brink, Guisarme unleashes an attack powerful enough to reduce anything to oblivion, the Mortal Dark Sphere. At long last, this climactic magic battle comes to a conclusion.

videos.title: I'll Join the Church!
videos.overview: Lloyd's interest in divine sorcery is piqued as a means of fighting off further demonic invasions.

videos.title: Jihriel's Miracles
videos.overview: After teleporting in the direction of a presence he sensed, Lloyd and Grim arrive in the realm of angels.

videos.title: Ghoul Hunting
videos.overview: Having learned the divine sorcery he was looking for, Lloyd searches for some undead to test it on.

videos.title: Civil War
videos.overview: Tao, Ren, and Sylpha encounter an undead with an incredibly dangerous power in the sewers.

videos.title: The Church's Secret
videos.overview: After Babylon's brutal defeat by the mysterious pastor, Lloyd's friends search for clues to his identity.

videos.title: Escher's Will
videos.overview: Lloyd's group discovers a gruesome secret beneath the church, leaving Escher to question her faith.

videos.title: The Great Advent Festival
videos.overview: Lloyd's group organizes to protect the bishops during the Advent festival.

videos.title: Invasion
videos.overview: Battle breaks out through the city as Lloyd's friends seek to defend against the unholy legion.

videos.title: The Moon and Tonkatsu
videos.overview: As Babylon contends with an immortal, infinitely regenerating pig chimera, Sylpha struggles without a sword.

videos.title: Black Dragon
videos.overview: Lloyd's friends are exhausted, but there's still the giant, infernal, dragon chimera to deal with.

videos.title: The Battle Above the Clouds
videos.overview: Lloyd and Guitane's clash, with the fate of Saloum in the balance, enters it's final stage.

videos.title: In the Light
videos.overview: Lloyd's overwhelming magic forces Guitane to confront his own doubts about god.
